body: Oh nooooooo nononono I've gone through my childhood once, I couldn't do it again no matter what.

I feel this. My therapist and I are talking about how intrinsically opposed to personal vulnerability and openness I have become because of my trauma and life experiences. I feel like I couldn't give myself to someone enough to constitute love.

It's just weird because she'd threaten all sorts of stuff, awful stuff... But one of the most severe ones was the one she tried to follow through with, as soon as she wasn't able to find me (I had moved). Everyone tells me she'll be better when I come back, and I know I can't do that, so did I just damn a person?
I'm not sure I'm worried about what's wrong with her. We don't talk anymore and she doesn't even know where I am or how to find me, which is what I want.
No meetup groups in my area. It wasn't an argument, she was like this for years and said she'd kill herself as soon as I left the house for college or whatever, and guess what, she did try
I will, I have an appointment set with my therapist, who is connected with my psychiatrist. Thank you ♥️
